failureBasis.observed: CCT emitted an I13 refusal although no forbidden I13 tag was present; every action merely carried at least one compiled axis harm.
failureBasis.change: I13 admissibility now depends only on forbidden constitutional tags. Material harms are routed to full-protection feasibility or attributable repair debt.

failureBasis.observed: CCT could not acquire capacity unless the world already labeled actions with CCT recovery kinds and maintenance booleans.
failureBasis.change: A bounded effect-evidence compiler may infer triage or capacity-acquisition candidates from disclosed current public axis effects, while independent receipts remain mandatory.

evidence: 19 local runtime, compatibility and mutation tests passed
both already observed Virelia projection profiles avoid the false I13 attribution
both profiles reach a bounded capacity-acquisition action and then reject the unverified gain
the Virelia replay is explicitly classified as post-failure development regression

boundaries.I13: Only an explicit frozen forbidden constitutional tag can establish I13 inadmissibility.
boundaries.materialHarm: A disclosed axis harm is not renamed I13; it can block full protection or create attributable repair debt during bounded recovery.
boundaries.unknownInstitution: Missing actor, recourse or observer evidence remains unknown and cannot be invented by the compiler.
boundaries.capacityEvidence: Positive public effect evidence may nominate an acquisition action but cannot certify its realized gain.
boundaries.terminalRule: Unverified capacity gain or unclosed repair debt at deadline remains terminal failure.

effectEvidence.axisDeltaMeaning: positive protects, negative harms, zero preserves on the named public proxy axis
compilerRules: triage candidate when vital and ecological deltas are positive
capacity-acquisition candidate when portability or recovery delta is positive
maintenance requires non-negative vital and ecological deltas
restoration is never inferred from effects alone

sequence.debtAxes: union of active uncovered axes and disclosed harmed axes

refusalTaxonomy.CCT_I13_NO_ADMISSIBLE_ACTION: every available action bears a forbidden constitutional tag
refusalTaxonomy.CCT_BUDGET_NO_ADMISSIBLE_ACTION: I13-safe actions exist but none fits the current budget
refusalTaxonomy.CCT_FULL_PROTECTION_INFEASIBLE: no zero-harm action protects all active axes and no valid triage exists
refusalTaxonomy.CCT_CAPACITY_ACQUISITION_INFEASIBLE: triage debt exists but no bounded acquisition candidate preserves the vital and ecological floors
refusalTaxonomy.CCT_CAPACITY_GAIN_UNVERIFIED: a nominated gain matured without an independent matching receipt

withdrawalConditions: Withdraw the patch if an action with a forbidden I13 tag becomes selectable.
Withdraw the new refusal taxonomy if a no-zero-harm scene is again labeled as I13 without a forbidden tag.
Withdraw effect compilation if hidden state, future events, outcome formulas or thresholds affect selection.
Withdraw inferred acquisition if it changes capacity without an independent matching receipt.
Any semantic change requires a new version and freeze.
The observed Virelia campaign is development evidence only and cannot promote this candidate.
